rules.title: Compare reasonable hypotheses
rules.summary: Generate and compare reasonable alternatives before committing to a preferred explanation.
rules.standard: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (1999)
rules.citation: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (CIA, Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999), Chapter 8, Step 1, printed pp. 96-99.

rules.title: Examine contrary evidence
rules.summary: Seek evidence that challenges hypotheses; evaluate whether expected evidence could actually have been observed before interpreting its absence.
rules.standard: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (1999)
rules.section: Chapter 8, Steps 2 and 5; Conclusions, printed pp. 99, 103-105, 108-109
rules.citation: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (CIA, Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999), Chapter 8, Steps 2 and 5; Conclusions, printed pp. 99, 103-105, 108-109.

rules.title: Keep analyst judgment explicit
rules.summary: Use a matrix to assist judgment; investigate disagreements between the matrix and the analyst instead of treating the matrix as the decision maker.
rules.standard: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (1999)
rules.citation: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (CIA, Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999), Chapter 8, Step 5, printed pp. 104-105.

rules.title: Revisit critical evidence
rules.summary: Examine how conclusions depend on critical evidence and assumptions, including errors and alternative interpretations.
rules.standard: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (1999)
rules.citation: Richards J. Heuer, Jr., Psychology of Intelligence Analysis (CIA, Center for the Study of Intelligence, 1999), Chapter 8, Step 6, printed pp. 105-106.

rules.title: Consider plausible alternatives
rules.summary: Assess plausible alternative explanations and identify observations that would change their assessed likelihood.
rules.standard: ICD 203, Analytic Standards (2 January 2015, as amended)
rules.citation: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, ICD 203 (2015, as amended), D.6.e.(4).

rules.title: Make reasoning assessable
rules.summary: Connect judgments to relevant information and coherent reasoning, acknowledging significant contrary information.
rules.standard: ICD 203, Analytic Standards (2 January 2015, as amended)
rules.citation: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, ICD 203 (2015, as amended), D.6.e.(6).

rules.title: Separate information, assumptions, and judgments
rules.summary: Distinguish source information, assumptions, and judgments; explain consequential assumptions and what changes if they fail.
rules.standard: ICD 203, Analytic Standards (2 January 2015, as amended)
rules.citation: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, ICD 203 (2015, as amended), D.6.e.(3).

rules.title: Describe the source basis
rules.summary: Identify the source and methodological basis of judgments, including relevant limits on quality and credibility.
rules.standard: ICD 203, Analytic Standards (2 January 2015, as amended)
rules.citation: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, ICD 203 (2015, as amended), D.6.e.(1).

rules.title: Explain uncertainty
rules.summary: Explain uncertainty in major judgments, distinguishing an event's likelihood from confidence in the judgment's evidential and reasoning basis.
rules.standard: ICD 203, Analytic Standards (2 January 2015, as amended)
rules.citation: Office of the Director of National Intelligence, ICD 203 (2015, as amended), D.6.e.(2).

rules.title: Retain observation dependence
rules.summary: Deduplicate explicit derivative origins without merging distinct observations. Test source, origin, and declared dependency groups during sensitivity analysis.
rules.citation: Local SAT engine implementation contract (9 September 2026), Computation and cross-record validation; this is an engine policy, not an external standard.

rules.title: Keep enrichment separate from canonical analysis
rules.summary: Add doctrine references only to derived renderings. Enrichment cannot rewrite canonical artifacts, fabricate citations, or certify compliance.
rules.citation: Local SAT engine implementation contract (9 September 2026), Doctrine; Canonical snapshot and artifacts; this is an engine policy, not an external standard.

rules.title: Qualify falsification and negative evidence
rules.summary: A contradiction rating is not verified falsification. Establish a necessary prediction, valid observation process, scope, and adequate detection coverage before excluding an explanation.
rules.citation: Local SAT engine implementation contract (9 September 2026), Corrected helper invariants: Judgment rules; this is an engine policy, not an external standard.

rules.title: Do not compute a causal winner
rules.summary: Descriptive ACH totals and variance do not determine causation, probability, or confidence. Preserve tied, incomplete, and insufficient states; any causal judgment remains analyst supplied.
rules.citation: Local SAT engine implementation contract (9 September 2026), Computation and cross-record validation; this is an engine policy, not an external standard.

rules.title: Keep unknown reliability unknown
rules.summary: Do not convert source reliability categories into numeric support weights or confidence adjustments. F and unknown remain unjudged.
rules.citation: Local SAT engine implementation contract (9 September 2026), Computation and cross-record validation; this is an engine policy, not an external standard.
